messages:
maria: Quick alert: after enabling speculative prefetch on the new 14b-quant rollout we've seen ~0.35% of responses that repeat an earlier prompt fragment instead of continuing. Happens more on long-context prompts. cc @rian

rian: thanks. do we have a minimal repro & request id? which quant tag and fallback chain?

maria: repro (redacted). req=req-2026-03-21-zz42. variant=q4_1 fallback=fp16->q4_1. sample output shows repetition of a line from the beginning of the conversation.

devon: possible causes: cache key lacks `quant_tag` or we use global prefix bucket that ignores `window_id`. i'll inspect keygen and prefetch apply paths.

jess_qa: I ran a focused sweep: 20k prompts with speculative on vs off, randomized sessions. repeat-rate ~0.33% with speculative, ~0.01% baseline. agrees with mux logs showing kv_apply on different `last_used` timestamps.

maria: ok plan: patch keygen to include `quant_tag` + `window_id`, add a toggle `speculative_key_strict`, canary 0.5% for 12h, run eval set N=30k. if repeat_rate > 0.15% rollback.

devon: will add unit tests and a debug sampling log `kv_key_parts` for 1/1000 requests. no migration needed; we'll accept initial misses.

ops-bot: deploy request queued: deploy/1777778999 -> canary(0.5%). Owner: devon. ETA 20m. :robot_face:

rian: consider adding a metric `kv_prefix_repeat` gated by route so we can alert automatically during rollouts.

maria: agreed. Jess, can you run the shadow harness and post results?

jess_qa: on it. I'll post a short table in 6h.

devon: patch pushed, CI green. starting canary now.

maria: thanks all 44d will follow up with the canary deck and rollback steps.
